ClientResponses.Response:
Hi, and congratulations on your new grill! We are glad to hear that you have been enjoying it, but we are sorry to hear about the corrosion. If your grill is located in a coastal or humid area, or if chlorine is present in your environment, additional maintenance will be needed to keep up the appearance of the exterior steel parts. Below are a couple helpful tips.

1. At the first sign of staining/discoloration/surface rust we would recommend cleaning with stainless steel cleaner. Once cleaned, we recommend using a stainless steel polish to keep it looking its best in-between cleanings.

2. Once a week we would recommend wiping down the grill with a wet towel or rag and then drying completely.

3. We would only recommend covering your grill if you know inclement weather is coming.

And please remember that the quicker you get at a stain, the easier it will be to clean off. 
If you need additional assistance, please reach out to us at support@weberstephen.com. We'll be glad to help. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I didn't need a real fancy grill. I just wanted a good grill that was convenient to use. I have a larger charcoal grill I use when I have company over and still believe it gives the best flavor. But, it is more difficult to use, requires a little more skill and time, and is harder to clean up. I wanted something smaller, faster, and easier to use for more of the everyday type use when its just me and the wife, and a gas grill seemed to fit that need. This grill has performed as advertised. Lights easily, cooks evenly, minimal flare-ups, well built, and I don't have to spend a lot of time preparing and cleaning up afterwards. That's a game changer for me, especially when its cold outside. Even though the food taste is not quite as good as charcoal it gets pretty close, it still has that grill taste that is hard to beat. I haven't tried using wood chips yet but would assume that would improve it even more. I would highly recommend this weber grill to anyone looking for those qualities in a grill.

Results.ReviewText:
I shopped around a, lot comparing features and prices, before buying mine " in the box" at Home Depot (they had them fully assembled but I wanted one without smudges and handprints all over it- also easier to transport home in my pickup).

Assembly instructions were as clear and accurate as can be, plus they have a cool 3-D app (which I didn't need to use. All parts were included and parts for various steps were bagged separately ( keep them that way). All the bolt holes lind up perfectly and nuts were often already welded in place to simplify things.Of course, all materials were of a very high caliber. When all done, it was beautiful.

I am following Weber's recipes and instructions to a tee and they work. My propane E-310 Spirit II ignites immediately and the burner controls are very accurate. The tank scale gauge is much better than the pressure gauges I've used in the past, which were pretty useless.
I bought an iGrill 3 wireless wifi thermometer to attach to the unit (very scarce in stores) but I tested it first by pairing the transmitter (with probe inserted in it) with my Samsung a10e phone (with Weber app) then I left phone at bbq and walked around to test range. Unfortunately, they would lose pairing consistently- evidenced by red pairing light on transmitter going out and transmitter turning off- when I entered the kitchen door a mere 15' away, rendering it unuseable inside my frame/stucco house. I returned it and bought another brand with separate transmitter and receiver (not wifi) with a huge range.

So far, I have cooked burgers ( my wife says "best ever"), lamb chops and tritip roast and uncooked Italian sausage- all to perfection.
I find you can Google Weber recipes for almost anything and they work.
I love it!
Results.Title: Worth the Price

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I was always told to get a Weber if I wanted a good grill. I will say this is the best grill I’ve ever owned!
Results.Title: New Weber Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: A great grill, honestly. You can control the heat well with the dials. GETS REAL HOT REAL FAST. Quality parts. I built mine out of the box and it took me a few hours but it wasn’t bad. One thing that confused me was that the manual is non-specific to the exact model grill I got. It was a manual for my grill (the Spirit II 310) as well as the 210 series. Once I figured that out, the instructions made more sense.
Results.Title: GREAT GRILL

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I received the Grill as a gift. I'm very pleased with it. The second time I used it ws to cook a leg of lamb.  It came out perfect!
Results.Title: Spirit II-310 Gas Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: A good grill with excellent temperature range.  The issues are that there is too much temperature different between the front and rear of the grill surface (middle and back or hotter than front), and the gap that allow airflow allow too much breeze to enter the grill.
Results.Title: Very good grill with a few small issues

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: While looking at the grill in the store, two firemen happen to be there and both said they have a Weber grill and they highly recommended I get it. I was hesitant because it was a little more than I was planning on spending but after using it the first time, it was sooo worth it.
Results.Title: Worth every penny

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Perfect starter grill for someone who loves grilling, great quality to give extra confidence while manning the grill.
Results.Title: First Weber Gas Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The spirit II E-310 Gas Grill, is a great grill, well built, solid materials, and most importantly it gets the job done. I’ve had it over a month now, since then I’ve done Steaks, burgers, hotdogs, skewers, veggies etc... grill maintains heat evenly, easy to assemble, easy to clean. I Love it, it has step up my grilling game :)
Results.Title: Best Grill ever

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Easy to use, great grilling results & simple cleanup.  Worth every penny.
Results.Title: Great grill.  Won’t disappoint!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill, I had a Spirit that lasted about 5 years until the base rotted out, the parts were so expensive it was more feasible to buy a new grill.  We'll see how long this one lasts.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: After years of lesser expensive grills that worked but always seemed to have some issue, it is great to have the Weber.  Everything works exactly as it should. Heats up fast, very hot. I hope to have this grill for many years!
Results.Title: Quality and longevity

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Great grill, I did research before I bought and knew it was the one to get. It was the right decision! My husband and I grill out every weekend now.
Results.Title: Get one

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Very good basic grill. Has what you need, nothing that you don’t.
Results.Title: Does the job

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: One of the best grills I've owned. I do find the rear portion of the grill is hotter than the rest. All in all, a great grill. I like the solid and sturdy cast grills.
Results.Title: New Weber

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Top notch grill. Very nice grates. Tank capacity scale is a neat innovation. I added the iGrill3 to the integrated mounting point and find it very useful. 

Well built, easy to assemble (but time consuming). VERY high quality components and precise machining of parts. Recommended!
Results.Title: QUALITY!!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We are very happy, so far, with our grill.  The fact is because we live in FL we use it often and it is fast and makes the meat cook just right.  The biggest selling point for us, at first, was it was assembled and delivered to the.house!
Results.Title: Great decision!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Best grill I’ve ever owned. Heat is even across the grill. Gets hot fast and stays hot. Easy to clean. Let’s you know how much propane you have left.
Results.Title: Best for me

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Works without issues, trusted name....size is fine for 3-6 people, all I need to compliment my pellet smoker in BBQing.  Price friendly....and the Spirit ll has a 10-yr. warranty (vs. the original Spirit with the closed cabinet).
